from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792486032/attempts/84bcef3cf5a14479a7d0101da055aebf/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value in (1, 2):
                points[value] = (r, c)
    r, c = points[1]
    tr, tc = points[2]
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1
    dr, dc = abs(tr - r), abs(tc - c)
    while dr > 1 and dc > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        dr -= 1
        dc -= 1
        out[r][c] = 3
    while dr > 1:
        r += sr
        dr -= 1
        out[r][c] = 3
    while dc > 1:
        c += sc
        dc -= 1
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
file_path = program_dir / 'task-decdaf0c.py'
file_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(file_path), 'exec'), globals())
